mapper.select: SELECT account_type AS accountType, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN account_type = 'SECURITIES' THEN COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(ih.market_value) FROM tbl_investment_holding ih WHERE ih.account_id = tbl_connected_account.id), balance) ELSE balance END ), 0) AS amount FROM tbl_connected_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 GROUP BY account_type

SELECT `year_month` AS yearMonth, net_worth AS netWorth, total_debt AS totalDebt FROM tbl_asset_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND net_worth IS NOT NULL AND `year_month` IN
#{yearMonth}
